full_page.content:
Page 114 Cont.
Mar. 1st Mrs. Mary Schwab ~ 60 - .... Mrs. Bridget Cushing - 50 - Flu - has six little ones
Mar. 8 Lillian Gross - 35 - Nerveous has wife and three small children, finds it quite an effort to keep up.
Patricia McCaffrey - 15 - T.B. in Detroit San .. Mrs. Sarah McCaffrey - 85 - grip ....
Page 115
Mar. 6th 7: 15 Ruth Mara - 14 - Apendicitis - pneumonia - strep poison, hope- less
7th Joseph Wolchon - 27 - in cast for almost three years with osteoma- litis of sholder joint. Was here for prayers and Enrollment in Ser. Mass Assoc'n - Since that time has been continually improving ever since cast was taken off six weeks ago. As yet can not bless him- self with right hand; but hopes to be able to do so shortly. Mrs. Howaid Dingler
Felix Portuesi - 50 - T. B. in Kiefer's - Practically no faith .... received Holy Communion on wedding day and 0 since - wife and chil- dren ask for prayers that he turn back to religion ...
Molly Alexander - 61 - cataracts - fears loss of sight
Mrs. Weber - against black magic Mrs. Dingler - in Grace Hospital ...
Winifred Champagne - 26 - broken foot last July - must have it rebroken.
Eliz Martin ... 34 ....
Victoria Savinska - 75 To-day very sick -
Page 116 Mar. 10 James Knapp of Toledo, 0. - 24 - ruptured apendix at Sept. - blood poison
